title: Backward through Time, Algebraically
abstract: arXiv:2608.17087v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Linear temporal logic is a modal extension of propositional logic that allows one to state how a system should behave over time. Its canonical domain is the booleans, but discretely-valued judgements are of little use in steering softly-valued systems (neural policies, adaptive controllers, sequence models, etc). In such cases, the goal formula's (dis)satisfaction becomes a training signal, and differentiability becomes a prime concern. Candidate differentiable semantics abound, but navigating them is tricky. Implementations, where available, are shallow embeddings, demanding an upfront commitment to a single semantic algebra and its (usually implicit) conduct. The paper casts the reader as a functional programmer asked to come to terms with this predicament, and refusing. translated_title: 穿越时间回溯，以代数方式
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.17087v1 公告类型：新 摘要：线性时序逻辑是命题逻辑的一种模态扩展，允许人们陈述系统应如何随时间行为。其典型领域是布尔值，但离散值判断在引导软值系统（如神经策略、自适应控制器、序列模型等）方面几乎无用。在这种情况下，目标公式的（不）满足性成为训练信号，可微性成为首要关注点。候选的可微语义众多，但导航它们很棘手。现有实现（如果有）是浅嵌入，要求预先承诺单一语义代数及其（通常隐含）行为。本文将读者塑造成一位函数式程序员，被要求接受这一困境，但拒绝接受。基于这种拒绝，产生了一个代数通用且可微的评估引擎，以及它所支持代数的可执行规范。
tldr: 本文提出了一种代数通用且可微的线性时序逻辑评估引擎，允许用户灵活选择语义代数，从而克服浅嵌入的局限性。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an algebra-generic and differentiable evaluation engine for linear temporal logic, enabling flexible semantic algebra selection and overcoming the limitations of shallow embeddings.
